google_review_notes: No login required. Everything in Word Search is reachable from the main menu: Play (500 themed word-search levels, 6x6 to 15x15, every grid checked so each listed word appears exactly once), Daily puzzle (one grid per day), Levels (level list plus Endless random grids), Shop, Settings (sound, music, vibration, language, notifications, Restore Purchases). Offline word game with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases. Word lists are English. Lives are only used by Endless grids; campaign levels and the Daily never cost a life.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open the Shop from Word Search's main menu. No demo account needed.
